newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices gain as arrivals fall.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices gain as arrivals fall.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices rose to 1,175/1,176 rupees per quintal from 1,168/1,169 rupees as arrivals dropped at producing centres, dealers said.
"New crop arrivals of castorseed dropped ahead of the kite festival as well as cold weather," one operator said.
The kite festival, a religious occasion, falls on January 14. Groundnut oil rose from 349/350 rupees to 352/353 rupees per 10 kg on fresh physical buying.
Rajkot spot oil was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg.
"Rising palm oil prices in the world market as well as in the local market also aided the firm tendency for groundnut oil," one miller said.
